ja.hint: 会話に出てくる一つの名前で答えてください。

title: Emily's idea
hint: Give a short sentence about the ad campaign she proposed.
sample: She suggested a new ad campaign.

ja.prompt: エミリーは何を提案しましたか？
ja.hint: 彼女が提案した広告について短い文で答えてください。
ja.sample: 彼女は新しい広告キャンペーンを提案しました。

local.hint: Answer with a short sentence about the ad campaign.
local.sample: She suggested a new ad campaign.

local_pron.sample: She suggested a new ad campaign.

zh.hint: 用一個短句說明她提出的廣告活動。

en.hint: Answer in one short sentence about the ad campaign she proposed.
en.sample: She suggested a new ad campaign.

en_pron.sample: She suggested a new ad campaign.

title: Task for next meeting
prompt: What will Sarah prepare for the next meeting?
hint: Say the full task as a short sentence: mention the sales report.
sample: She will prepare the sales report.

ja.prompt: サラは次の会議のために何を準備しますか？
ja.hint: 売上報告書であることを含めた短い文で答えてください。
ja.sample: 彼女は売上報告書を準備します。

local.prompt: What will Sarah prepare for the next meeting?
local.hint: Give a short sentence stating she will prepare the sales report.
local.sample: She will prepare the sales report.

local_pron.prompt: What will Sarah prepare for the next meeting?
local_pron.hint: Speak the full short sentence clearly.
local_pron.sample: She will prepare the sales report.

zh.prompt: 莎拉會為下次會議準備什麼？

en.prompt: What will Sarah prepare for the next meeting?
